lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: بُعْثِرَتْ is in the derivative form: بُعْثِرَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/ع/ث/ر   b–ʿ–th–r to scatter, to strew about; to squander; to disarrange, to turn inside out. Of this root, بُعْثِرَ buʿthira occurs 2 times in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
بُعْثِرَ buʿthira [pass. quad. v.] to be strewn about, to be scattered all over; to be turned inside out

(82:4) وَإِذَا الْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ when graves are turned inside out.
